# Aaron Ivory

**Role:** Step-brother (Sheryle's son, Mark's step-brother through Tim)
**Residence:** Adelaide, South Australia (originally Brisbane, QLD)
**Education:** The University of Adelaide — MBA (2020–2022)
---

## Family

## Life Summary

Sheryle Telfer's son from her first marriage to Paul Ivory. Step-brother to Mark and Amy through Sheryle's marriage to Tim (28 Aug 1999). Lives in Adelaide with his wife Karina.
